name: shell-tail
description: Lists every shell still running above the prompt: how long it has run, how much it wrote, and its last line (terminal)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn this mod off without removing it. Takes effect at once.

rows.title: Rows in the band
rows.description: The most rows the band takes above the prompt. Past it, the newest shells are counted on one last row: +N more.
